No API key required. Call this first to discover what is available.

tools.name: list_rule_changes
tools.description: List the dated changes to NorthPoint's regulations library, newest first: each correction to a rule record (from -> to), why, and the official text it was read from. Every rule from get_regulation also carries last_read_at_source. Filter by since (YYYY-MM-DD) and regime. No key needed.

tools.name: run_mica_pro_check
tools.description: Run the full MiCA (EU cryptoasset marketing) self-audit on a marketing asset. ~40 rules covering Title II–IV, ESMA guidance, and operator-grade interpretive notes. Returns verdict, per-rule analysis, and rewrite suggestions.

tools.name: run_gdpr_pro_check
tools.description: Run the full GDPR + ePrivacy marketing self-audit (~30 rules). Cookie banners, email/SMS opt-in, signup forms, privacy notices, marketing automation, ad-pixel placement. Returns verdict, per-rule analysis, and rewrite suggestions.

tools.name: run_fca_pro_check
tools.description: Run the full FCA UK financial-promotions self-audit for cryptoasset marketing (~25 rules). Section 21 FSMA, COBS 4.12A, PERG 8, the October 2023 cryptoasset regime, HTX precedent. Returns verdict + per-rule analysis + rewrite suggestions.

tools.name: run_sec_pro_check
tools.description: Run the SEC retail communications self-audit (~25 rules) for US-touching crypto marketing. FINRA Rule 2210, anti-fraud, Reg BI, finfluencer compensation disclosures, securities-status framing.

tools.name: run_mas_pro_check
tools.description: Run the full MAS Singapore DPT marketing self-audit (~35–40 rules). PS Act, Notice PSN02, January 2022 prohibition on public-space DPT advertising, AML/CFT communications requirements.

tools.name: run_vara_pro_check
tools.description: Run the full VARA Dubai marketing self-audit (~35–40 rules). Marketing & Promotions Rulebook, pre-approval requirements, KOL contracts, risk warnings, prohibited content.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lookup_regulation, get_regulation, run_gdpr_pro_check, run_tge_readiness_check, run_ad_creative_check, get_latest_signal, search_signals · Private data: list_regimes, get_lite_ruleset, list_jurisdictions, lookup_regulation, get_regulation, list_rule_changes, run_tge_readiness_check, get_latest_signal, search_signals · Public sink: run_gdpr_pro_check · Destructive: get_lite_ruleset, run_mica_pro_check, run_gdpr_pro_check, run_fca_pro_check, run_sec_pro_check, run_mas_pro_check, run_vara_pro_check, run_tge_readiness_check, run_aeo_visibility_check, run_ad_creative_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lookup_regulation, get_regulation, run_gdpr_pro_check, run_tge_readiness_check, run_ad_creative_check, get_latest_signal, search_signals · Private data: list_regimes, get_lite_ruleset, list_jurisdictions, lookup_regulation, get_regulation, list_rule_changes, run_tge_readiness_check, get_latest_signal, search_signals · Public sink: run_gdpr_pro_check · Destructive: get_lite_ruleset, run_mica_pro_check, run_gdpr_pro_check, run_fca_pro_check, run_sec_pro_check, run_mas_pro_check, run_vara_pro_check, run_tge_readiness_check, run_aeo_visibility_check, run_ad_creative_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
